title: Power BI Engineer
description:
**req id:** 385120
  
  

ntt data strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. if you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

we are currently seeking a power bi engineer to join our team in dallas, texas (us\-tx), united states (us). plesae note that this role is slated to be on\-site 5 days/week.
  
  

**responsibilities:**  

requirements gathering analysis
  
collaborate with business stakeholders, department heads, and executive leadership to gather, document, and analyze business intelligence and reporting requirements; translate business questions into technical specifications for data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
  
  

data modeling architecture
  
design and develop logical and physical data models (star schema, snowflake schema) to support enterprise reporting needs; define fact and dimension tables, establish relationships, and optimize data structures for query performance and scalability.
  
  

etl/data pipeline development
  
design, build, and maintain extract, transform, load (etl/elt) processes to consolidate data from multiple heterogeneous source systems (e.g., sql server, oracle, sap, salesforce, cloud data warehouses) into centralized data warehouses or data marts, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  
  

power bi dashboard report development
  
design, develop, and deploy interactive dashboards, scorecards, and reports using microsoft power bi, including:
  
building complex dax (data analysis expressions) measures, calculated columns, and calculated tables for advanced business metrics (kpis, yoy/mom trends, running totals, variance analysis)
  
developing and optimizing power query (m language) transformations for data cleansing, shaping, and integration
  
constructing and maintaining power bi data models using best practices for relationships, cardinality, and row\-level security (rls)
  
publishing and managing reports/datasets via the power bi service, configuring scheduled data refreshes, gateways (on\-premises data gateway), and workspace access controls
  
creating reusable power bi templates, custom visuals, and paginated reports (power bi report builder) for standardized enterprise reporting
  
implementing power bi premium/fabric capacity optimization techniques to manage performance for large datasets
  
  

sql development database querying
  
write and optimize complex sql queries, stored procedures, views, and functions to extract, aggregate, and analyze large datasets from relational databases; perform query performance tuning and indexing recommendations.
  
  

data analysis statistical interpretation
  
conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of business data to identify trends, patterns, correlations, and anomalies; apply statistical methods to support forecasting, variance analysis, and root\-cause investigation of business performance issues.
  
  

kpi development performance metrics
  
partner with business units (finance, sales, operations, risk, or client delivery) to define, standardize, and track key performance indicators (kpis) and metrics aligned with organizational strategic goals.
  
  

data governance quality assurance
  
establish and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and reconciliation processes; document data lineage, business logic, and metadata to maintain a single source of truth across reporting platforms.
  
  

cross\-functional collaboration
  
work closely with data engineers, database administrators, software developers, and business analysts to ensure bi solutions integrate seamlessly with enterprise data architecture and align with it governance standards.
  
  

ad hoc self\-service analytics enablement
  
develop self\-service bi capabilities by training business users on power bi report consumption and basic report authoring; create documentation, data dictionaries, and user guides to support organizational bi adoption.
  
  

presentation of insights to leadership
  
prepare and present analytical findings, dashboards, and business recommendations to senior management and executive stakeholders to support data\-driven decision\-making.
  
  

tool technology evaluation
  
evaluate and recommend bi tools, visualization techniques, and emerging technologies (e.g., power bi, tableau, azure synapse, microsoft fabric, python/r for advanced analytics) to enhance the organization's business intelligence capabilities.
  
  

security compliance
  
implement role\-based access controls and row\-level security within bi platforms to ensure sensitive business and financial data is accessed only by authorized personnel, in compliance with organizational and regulatory data governance policies.
  
  

documentation change management
  
maintain technical documentation for bi solutions including data flow diagrams, source\-to\-target mappings, and version control of power bi reports/datasets; manage change requests and enhancements through a structured sdlc/agile process.
  
  

required qualifications
  
* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, engineering, or related field.
* 5–7 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or reporting.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with power bi desktop and power bi service.
* 2\+ years experience in in dax, power query (m), and sql.


preferred qualifications
  
* knowledge of python, power automate, or automation frameworks.
* familiarity with ci/cd pipelines and azure devops.
* experience with dimensional modeling, star schemas, and semantic models.
* strong understanding of data warehousing concepts.
* experience working with large datasets and performance optimization techniques.
* excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* experience in banking, financial services, risk analytics, or capital markets.
* microsoft certified: power bi data analyst associate certification preferred.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Databricks
description:
colas is support is the information technology arm of the north america business for colas and is based in denver, colorado. colas iss strives to make colas an industry leader through developing custom mobile applications and business intelligence tools, supporting core applications, maintaining our infrastructure, and much more. through a partnership with the colas companies in the usa \& canada colas is support helps empower our employees for success while also providing direct contact with users and other innovators across the organization. to learn more about colas is support visit www.colasiss.com/.

  

the colas usa family of companies provides competitive pay, outstanding benefits, career advancement opportunities, professional education, and extensive training for every employee. we pride ourselves on upholding the highest standards of safety, environmental conservation, and ethical conduct as we strive to grow our infrastructure products and services through empowering and developing our people, fostering innovation, utilizing new technology, and maximizing vertical integration at all levels of the company’s value chain. to learn more about the colas usa family of companies, please visit www.colasusa.com.

**mission**
-----------


colas is one of north america’s largest road and infrastructure groups, and colas iss provides the technology and data services that keep the business running. databricks is our long\-term data platform, and we are looking for a senior data engineer to build and own it. our current major initiative is erdw.next, the migration of our enterprise reporting \& data warehouse onto databricks; when that lands, this role continues as the technical owner of the platform and of every new data domain we bring onto it.


this is a hands\-on, build\-first role, and deliberately more than a tools role. we want an engineer who brings architect\-level thinking to enterprise data—target\-state design, modeling and governance standards, and a sequenced migration path off our legacy sql server / synapse / ssrs estate—and who then writes the production code that makes it real. design authority here is earned by building: most of your time will be spent engineering, not advising.


you own the data platform’s architecture and are accountable for it working in production, within the enterprise direction set by our enterprise architect. this is a senior individual\-contributor role with no direct reports; delivery priorities and partner direction sit with the manager, application development \& data engineering. you will work directly with our power bi developers, data engineers, business users and citizen developers across finance, construction, equipment, and safety, and our offshore delivery partners.

**compensation \& benefits**
----------------------------


compensation\*: **$119,340\.00 – $145,860\.00 usd**

* *estimated target starting compensation; final compensation will be determined based on an assessment of an individual’s qualifications, education, and experience relevant to the role.*


benefits: full\-time salaried exempt employees are eligible for colas group benefits, as outlined in the plan documents. available benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, term life insurance, supplemental life insurance, 401(k) with company match, short\- and long\-term disability. other benefits include paid holidays, paid sick leave, accrued vacation time off, and paid parental leave.


other compensation: this position may be considered for annual bonus compensation.

**responsibilities**
--------------------

**platform architecture \& design**

* own the technical design of the erdw.next lakehouse: medallion layering, delta table design, and the gold layer that feeds power bi.
* set the platform roadmap and defend pattern\-level decisions — batch vs. streaming, delta live tables vs. workflows, where transformation logic belongs.
* define enterprise data modeling standards: conformed dimensions, gold\-layer star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, grain, and naming.
* partner with the enterprise architect on the data governance framework, jd edwards data strategy, and enterprise integration patterns.

**build \& migration**

* stay hands\-on in the codebase, writing and reviewing production pipelines as the primary way you set technical standards.
* build and optimize pipelines in pyspark, spark sql, and delta live tables, orchestrated through databricks workflows.
* engineer ingestion from jd edwards, bms, cms, cority, hcss, intelex, and anaplan using cdc, auto loader, and merge.
* drive migration of legacy workloads (sql server procedures, ssis, synapse, adf, qlik replicate) with a defensible parallel\-run and cutover approach.

**running the platform**

* own technical delivery of the data platform workstream: sequence the build, surface dependencies and risk early, and land your half to plan.
* tune performance and cost: liquid clustering, optimize / z\-order, photon, and right\-sized clusters, with clear accountability for consumption.
* engineer reliability: data quality expectations, restartable pipelines, monitoring, and dependable slas through month\-end close.
* establish and maintain ci/cd: git\-based development, databricks asset bundles, promotion across environments, and automated testing.

**governance \& trusted data**

* design and implement the unity catalog governance model: catalog structure, entitlements, lineage, classification, and audit.
* build semantic models with rich metadata, business definitions, and synonyms, so data is trustworthy for reporting and ai consumption alike.
* capture design rationale in architecture decision records and runbooks, so the platform never depends on one person or partner.

**self\-service \& ai enablement**

* curate databricks genie agents over the gold layer: datasets, example queries, business semantics, and verified answers.
* work directly with business users and citizen developers across finance, construction, equipment, and safety.
* make certified data the easiest path to use and raise their capability, rather than gatekeeping behind a request queue.
* partner with power bi developers on the serving layer beneath their semantic models, deciding what belongs where.

**ai\-assisted engineering**

* use agentic coding tools as a regular part of your workflow to accelerate pipeline development, legacy code migration, and testing.
* own the correctness of ai\-generated output: you review it, verify it, and remain accountable for what reaches production.

**legacy estate, partners \& communication**

* provide senior\-level support and change\-request delivery on the legacy erdw estate (t\-sql, ssrs, synapse, adf) while it remains in service.
* hold the engineering quality bar across offshore partner work (datavail, birlasoft) through design and code reviews and a clear definition of done.
* communicate architecture, risk, and cost trade\-offs to it leadership and business stakeholders in plain language.
**experience**
--------------

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building production data platforms on databricks / apache spark, backed by 8\+ years of overall experience in data engineering, data warehousing, and business intelligence.
* demonstrated ownership of the technical design of at least one enterprise data warehouse or lakehouse platform end to end—from target\-state design through production delivery—rather than solely executing a design set by others.
* currently hands\-on in code and intending to remain so. this is not a design\-only, advisory, or oversight position; candidates seeking to move away from day\-to\-day engineering will not be a fit.
* proven track record migrating legacy on\-premises or first\-generation cloud warehouse workloads (sql server, ssis, synapse, adf) to a modern lakehouse architecture.
* experience sourcing data from erp and operational systems (jd edwards strongly preferred) and delivering finance and operational reporting at enterprise scale.
* experience enabling a self\-service analytics community—business users, analysts, or citizen developers—through curated data and guardrails rather than a ticket queue.
* agentic coding tools are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of what they produce.
* experience reviewing the work of offshore or partner development teams and holding a consistent quality bar across them.
* preferred certifications: databricks certified data engineer professional and / or databricks certified data architect; azure dp\-203 or az\-305 a plus.
**professional skills**
-----------------------

* **platform design \& data strategy:** able to define a target\-state design and a sequenced migration roadmap, and to defend the trade\-offs to both engineers and executives (must\-have).
* **databricks platform:** expert across databricks sql, workflows / jobs, delta live tables, unity catalog, auto loader, photon, and cluster / sql warehouse configuration (must\-have).
* **spark \& python:** advanced pyspark and spark sql, writing modular, tested, reusable code rather than one\-off notebooks (must\-have).
* **delta lake:** deep proficiency—merge / upserts, time travel, optimize, z\-order, liquid clustering, partitioning, vacuum, and schema evolution.
* **enterprise \& dimensional data modeling:** star schema, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, and grain design—including a gold layer purpose\-built for a power bi semantic layer (must\-have).
* **sql:** expert sql / t\-sql, including the ability to read and re\-engineer large, complex legacy stored procedures.
* **data governance:** unity catalog, access control and entitlements, lineage, data classification, data quality frameworks, and master data / metric definition.
* **conversational \& agentic analytics:** curating natural\-language query layers over governed data—dataset selection, business semantics, synonyms, verified answers, and evaluation. databricks genie experience a plus.
* **self\-service enablement:** making certified data usable by business users and citizen developers through documentation, guardrails, and coaching rather than gatekeeping.
* **azure data platform:** adls gen2, azure data factory, azure synapse, key vault, entra id, and the networking fundamentals behind secure data services.
* **ingestion \& replication:** cdc and replication tooling (qlik replicate or equivalent), api and file\-based ingestion, and structured streaming concepts.
* **devops \& ci/cd:** git, azure devops or github actions, databricks asset bundles / repos, automated testing, and infrastructure as code (terraform a plus).
* **performance \& cost optimization:** job and query tuning, cluster right\-sizing, workload isolation, and demonstrable cloud cost management.
* **bi integration:** solid understanding of power bi semantic models and of direct lake / directquery / import trade\-offs, plus microsoft fabric and onelake.
* **legacy estate:** working capability across sql server, ssis, ssrs / paginated reporting, synapse, and adf to support the existing erdw platform during transition.
* **ai\-assisted delivery:** fluent use of agentic coding assistants in day\-to\-day engineering, paired with the judgment to know when the output is wrong.
* **business domain:** finance / p\&l reporting logic; construction, equipment, or safety domains a plus. jd edwards source\-system knowledge is highly valued.
**soft skills**
---------------

* **communication skills:** ability to convey complex technical concepts and architectural trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
* **collaboration:** working effectively with cross\-functional teams including developers, project managers, business analysts, citizen developers, and offshore delivery partners.
* **problem\-solving:** analyzing issues and developing effective solutions while considering constraints and trade\-offs.
* **technical influence:** influencing technical decision\-making through demonstrated expertise rather than formal authority, and raising the capability of the engineers around you.
* **ownership \& bias for action:** comfortable acting as the go\-to technical authority and driving decisions to closure while the platform is still being defined.
* **adaptability:** openness to change and emerging technologies.
* **critical thinking:** evaluating options and making informed decisions.
* **time management:** prioritizing effectively across new platform build, legacy support, and governance work.
* **empathy:** understanding team and stakeholder perspectives to foster collaboration.
**disclaimer**
--------------


this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications and may be amended to meet business needs.


colas inc. and its subsidiaries are an equal opportunity employer. for details on the specifics of this commitment, if you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to:

* to meet the requirements of the role in which you are applying
* complete any part of the application process
* access or use the online application process and need an alternative method for applying

  

please contact colas inc. at 973\-290\-9082 or send an email to colasrecruiter@colasinc.com.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**description**

we are looking for a highly motivated and self\-driven software developer to join our data ingestion automation team. a new member of the team will have the opportunity to work with some of the largest education datasets in the world gathered through pearson’s online learning products.


the core mission of the data ingestion automation team is to enable and automate the ingestion of data to improve pearson products, learning content, and learner experience. the position provides the opportunity to engage in cutting\-edge development and to make a substantial contribution to learning and instruction. this position will have the opportunity to pioneer the adoption of ai to enable more rapid data capture utilizing both aws and gcp hyperscalers.


we are bold thinkers and standout innovators who motivate each other to explore new frontiers in an environment that supports and inspires us to always improve.


by pushing the boundaries of technology and pushing each other to surpass them, we create an environment that leads not only the education industry but creates seeds of learning that become the catalyst for the world’s innovations, personal and global, large and small.


**responsibilities:**

* designs and implements new, unit tested software.
* maintains and enhances existing software.
* actively participates in customer, requirements, architecture, and design meetings.
* enjoys a healthy technical debate but knows how to collaboratively solve problems that move everyone forward.
* uses logical analysis, theoretical deduction, and sound reasoning to troubleshoot challenging technical and business problems.
* contributes to the continuous integration pipeline deploying into both aws and gcp environments utilizing terraform.
* works efficiently and collaboratively in an agile (scrum or kanban) team environment.
* follows devops practices: owning software application(s) and code from development through deployment.
* works with big data technologies (kinesis, sqs, bigquery) that deal with large\-scale distributed data processing.

**qualifications:**

* detail\-oriented, self\-directed, and self\-motivated with a strong capacity for working successfully and flexibly with members across the organization.
* willingness and ability to quickly learn complex information systems.
* stays current on industry trends and formulates an opinion on the pros and cons of each.
* experienced with software performance, observability, scalability, maintainability, reusability and security.
* a good foundation in computer science with strong competencies in basic data structures, jvm concurrency, thread safety, and oo design for solving day\-to\-day problems.
* ability to independently learn and actively seek new skills and knowledge to advance the development capabilities of the organization.
* ability to effectively use ai\-assisted tools to accelerate day\-to\-day development, automation, troubleshooting, and data engineering activities while maintaining accuracy, quality, and responsible usage standards.
* ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical people, and work with a variety of internal and external development groups.
* willingness to pivot technologies, solutions, and projects as the mission dictates.

education and/or experience


* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science / mis or equivalent experience
* minimum three (3\) years of experience in software engineering and design

required


* a “can\-do” attitude
* willingness to learn new technologies
* experience with java and python
* experience with rest\-based web services
* experience with maven or similar build tool
* experience with unit testing and mock frameworks
* aws and/or gcp experience
* practice with git or similar source control system
* strong foundation in linux

preferred (nice to have)


* aws cloud experience in kinesis, aurora, sqs, ec2, ecs, and/or lambda
* gcp cloud experience in bigquery, airflow, gks, cloud run
* database design experience (sql or nosql)
* experience with high volume systems
* understanding of best practices in security (ssl, tls, ssh, public key encryption, etc.)
* understanding of tcp/ip based computer networking
* spring boot
* spring graphql

title: Senior AI/ML Platform Engineer, GovCloud
description:
overview:

medallia is the pioneer and market leader in experience management. our award\-winning saas platform, medallia experience cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.


we believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. experiences shape the way people feel about a company. and they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. at medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.


we empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.


bring your whole self.

  

the role and team


we are looking for a senior ai/ml engineer to join our medallia ai platform team and lead the migration of our ai platform to aws govcloud. this role requires us citizenship due to govcloud access and deployment requirements.


as a senior ai/ml engineer on the ai platform team, you will architect and develop the building blocks of our next\-generation ai products while spearheading our govcloud migration initiative. you will work with cross\-functional teams to deliver world\-class ai capabilities to government and enterprise customers.

  


responsibilities:
* lead the migration of our ai/ml platform services to aws govcloud, ensuring compliance, security, and performance standards.
* design and implement cloud\-native ml infrastructure on aws, including sagemaker, ecs, eks, and lambda.
* monitor, maintain, and optimize deployed models and ml pipelines in govcloud environments.
* build and maintain secure data pipelines across national boundaries, adhering to fedramp requirements.
* collaborate with product and design teams to build innovative features for the customer experience space.
* architect scalable solutions for large\-scale data processing made available to clients with high performance.
* design and implement apis to power front\-end applications.
* identify process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, redesigning infrastructure for greater scalability.
* participate in a scheduled on\-call rotation to maintain the availability and reliability of both internal platforms and customer\-facing production systems.


candidates based in the tysons vicinity will be prioritized as this role is hybrid, 3 days per week onsite.


qualifications:
**minimum qualifications**

* eligibility requirement: due to compliance restrictions for aws govcloud environments, us citizenship is required for this role. candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain access to these secure environments.
* ba/bs degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of software development in production environments using python, java, or scala.
* demonstrated experience deploying and operating services on kubernetes (k8s); familiarity with k8s\-based deployment frameworks in regulated environments.
* demonstrated experience with distributed systems: spark, hadoop, kafka.
* demonstrated experience with relational sql including postgres.
* demonstrated experience with code quality best practices and testing architectures on large codebases.

**preferred qualifications**

* familiarity with aws services (ec2, s3, iam, vpc, eks, sagemaker) for cases where native aws deployments are required outside the company's k8s framework.
* experience with aws govcloud or fedramp\-compliant environments.
* aws certified machine learning specialty or solutions architect certification.
* experience with ml model serving platforms: tensorflow serving, tensorrt, triton, kserve.
* experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as airflow or kubeflow.
* microservices development using django or spring framework.
* experience with nosql databases including elasticsearch.

  

medallia is committed to equal pay and transparency. the annual base salary range for this position is $148,500 \- $221,000\. please note that the salary range information provided is a general guideline and combines all of the distinct labor markets within the us. it is uncommon for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on a variety of factors. medallia considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, candidate’s work location, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, external market data, as well as, market and business considerations when making compensation decisions.

title: Statistical Modeling & Global Conflict Foresight Fellow International Truth & Trauma Institute
description:
statistical modeling \& global conflict foresight fellow

international truth \& trauma institute (itti) / outlets for hope, inc.

**job type:** fellowship / internship  
**compensation:** **unpaid internship / fellowship**  
**work setting:** remote  
**start date:** immediate / fall 2026  
**organization:** international truth \& trauma institute (itti), a program of outlets for hope, inc.

about the fellowship

the **international truth \& trauma institute (itti)** is seeking an exceptional, quantitatively skilled fellow to join its research and technology team.

this is an **unpaid educational fellowship/internship** designed for a highly motivated student, graduate, recent graduate, researcher, or early\-career professional seeking substantive experience at the intersection of **statistical modeling, data science, conflict forecasting, political instability, collective trauma, public policy, and digital research infrastructure**.

students seeking **internship, practicum, field\-placement, capstone, research, or school\-required experiential hours** are encouraged to apply where permitted by their academic institution.

this is **not a routine administrative internship**.

the successful candidate will participate directly in the development of itti's emerging **global conflict foresight system (gcfs™)**—a scientific forecasting architecture intended to estimate conflict and destabilization risks across multiple forecasting horizons and translate those forecasts into actionable intelligence for governments, humanitarian organizations, researchers, and corporations.

the fellow will also help maintain and develop itti's web\-based research infrastructure, including **ittiglobal.org** and related observatory/dashboard environments.

the primary assignment: building the gcfs™

the successful candidate will work with itti leadership to help transform an existing conceptual scientific architecture into a functioning quantitative forecasting system.

the gcfs™ is envisioned as a forward\-looking conflict probability and escalation engine incorporating itti's existing and emerging research frameworks, including the:

* **global trauma burden index (gtbi)**
* **election trauma temperature index (etti)**
* conflict and political\-violence indicators
* institutional\-stability measures
* economic stress indicators
* displacement and humanitarian indicators
* governance variables
* social and demographic indicators
* election\-cycle variables
* historical conflict patterns
* geospatial and event\-level data
* other empirically defensible predictors of instability and armed conflict

the objective is not merely to describe where violence has already occurred.

the fellow will help itti develop models capable of asking:

**what is likely to happen next, where, when, with what probability, and with what consequences?**

key responsibilities1\. statistical \& predictive modeling

assist in designing, testing, refining, and documenting statistical models capable of estimating conflict onset, escalation, persistence, and related instability.

work may include:

* regression modeling
* logistic/probit models
* time\-series analysis
* panel\-data models
* survival/hazard models
* bayesian modeling
* machine\-learning approaches
* ensemble forecasting
* anomaly detection
* classification and clustering
* geospatial modeling
* model calibration and validation
* uncertainty estimation
* sensitivity analysis
* feature engineering and variable selection

the fellow should be comfortable determining **which modeling approach is scientifically appropriate**, rather than simply running predetermined analyses.

2\. multi\-horizon conflict forecasting

help develop forecasting methodologies for approximately:

**1\-month \| 3\-month \| 6\-month \| 12\-month \| 24\-month horizons**

potential outputs include:

* probability of conflict onset
* probability of conflict escalation
* political\-violence risk
* election\-related instability
* geographic conflict hotspots
* humanitarian deterioration
* institutional destabilization
* displacement risk
* corporate and supply\-chain exposure

3\. data architecture \& dataset integration

identify, clean, structure, merge, and analyze large international datasets.

potential data sources may include conflict\-event databases, governance indicators, socioeconomic datasets, election data, humanitarian statistics, population information, geospatial data, public\-health datasets, institutional indicators, and other reputable international data sources.

responsibilities may include:

* api\-based data acquisition
* dataset harmonization
* missing\-data management
* longitudinal dataset construction
* country\-level and subnational data integration
* automated data pipelines
* reproducible analytical workflows
* data\-quality assessment
* creation of research\-ready analytical datasets

4\. model validation

help establish a rigorous validation framework for gcfs™.

this may include:

* training/testing separation
* rolling\-origin validation
* out\-of\-sample forecasting
* back\-testing against historical conflicts
* precision/recall assessment
* roc\-auc and related classification measures
* brier scores
* calibration testing
* false\-positive/false\-negative analysis
* benchmark comparisons
* model\-drift monitoring

the goal is to ensure that itti's forecasts are **scientifically defensible, reproducible, measurable, and continuously improvable**.

5\. risk\-scoring architecture

assist in translating statistical outputs into interpretable risk categories and indices suitable for policymakers, researchers, governments, humanitarian organizations, and businesses.

the fellow may help develop:

* country risk scores
* escalation scores
* election\-instability scores
* trauma\-vulnerability scores
* geographic hotspot classifications
* confidence intervals
* warning thresholds
* watchlists
* risk trajectories
* composite indices

6\. corporate impact \& preparedness modeling

an important component of the project involves translating conflict forecasts into measurable organizational consequences.

the fellow may help model potential effects on:

* supply chains
* transportation corridors
* shipping and freight
* workforce safety
* business continuity
* market access
* commodity exposure
* insurance risk
* infrastructure
* operational costs
* displacement
* regulatory environments
* corporate assets

the long\-term objective is to help transform gcfs™ forecasts into professional **conflict preparedness \& enterprise impact reports** for organizations exposed to geopolitical and conflict\-related risks.

7\. dashboard \& data visualization development

help translate complex modeling results into understandable digital outputs such as:

* interactive maps
* country profiles
* forecasting dashboards
* trend charts
* risk gauges
* heat maps
* early\-warning indicators
* scenario displays
* country comparisons
* downloadable research outputs

8\. itti website \& digital infrastructure

**candidates must have the technical ability to maintain and update a professional website such as ittiglobal.org, or demonstrate strong transferable web\-development skills.**

responsibilities may include:

* maintaining website pages
* updating research and observatory content
* publishing reports and datasets
* troubleshooting website issues
* embedding visualizations
* maintaining dashboard interfaces
* improving website functionality
* supporting data\-to\-web integration
* maintaining organized digital research resources

this fellowship therefore requires someone who is comfortable working across both **quantitative research and digital/web environments**.

required technical qualifications

applicants **must possess strong statistical modeling skills**.

this requirement is central to the fellowship.

competitive candidates should demonstrate experience with several of the following:

* python
* r
* matlab
* sql
* statistical analysis
* predictive analytics
* machine learning
* time\-series forecasting
* regression analysis
* data visualization
* large\-dataset management
* geospatial analysis
* api/data integration
* web development or website administration

experience with tools or libraries such as **pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, tensorflow, pytorch, geopandas, plotly, power bi, tableau, or comparable analytical technologies** is valuable.

applicants do **not** need to know every technology listed above.

however, applicants without substantive statistical or quantitative modeling ability are unlikely to be a good fit for this particular fellowship.

preferred academic background

strong applicants may come from:

* data science
* statistics
* applied mathematics
* computer science
* artificial intelligence / machine learning
* economics / econometrics
* political science with strong quantitative training
* computational social science
* public policy
* international relations with quantitative methods
* epidemiology / biostatistics
* geographic information systems
* operations research
* engineering
* related quantitative disciplines

graduate students, doctoral students, advanced undergraduate students, recent graduates, and qualified early\-career professionals are encouraged to apply.

the candidate we are looking for

the ideal fellow is someone who sees a conceptual forecasting architecture and immediately begins thinking:

**what variables do we need? where will the data come from? how should we structure the panel? what model families should we test? how do we validate the predictions? how do we quantify uncertainty? and how do we turn the results into a usable dashboard?**

we are especially interested in candidates who can **build**, not merely discuss, quantitative models.

candidates should be:

* intellectually curious
* quantitatively rigorous
* comfortable with independent research
* capable of working with imperfect real\-world datasets
* able to document their methodology
* responsive to supervision and feedback
* dependable in a remote environment
* interested in conflict, trauma, international affairs, humanitarian issues, or global stability

fellowship learning \& professional development

this fellowship is intended to provide meaningful experiential learning rather than routine clerical work.

depending on performance and project progress, fellows may gain experience in:

* development of a real\-world predictive modeling system
* international conflict analytics
* early\-warning methodology
* statistical model development
* global datasets
* machine learning
* scientific validation
* data visualization
* research publication
* web\-based research dissemination
* policy analysis
* interdisciplinary research collaboration

fellows may also develop substantial **portfolio\-quality work** demonstrating experience in predictive analytics, global risk research, and data\-driven policy analysis.

where appropriate, itti may work with educational institutions regarding approved internship, practicum, or experiential\-learning requirements.

fellowship recognition

successful fellows may become eligible, subject to satisfactory completion and itti requirements, for recognition within the **itti fellowship program** and opportunities for continued participation in itti research initiatives.

outstanding fellows may also be considered for future research collaboration, publication participation, project leadership, references/recommendations, or advanced responsibilities within the institute.

schedule \& remote participation

this is a **remote fellowship/internship**.

applicants must have:

* reliable internet access
* dependable computer access
* ability to participate in scheduled virtual meetings
* ability to work independently between supervisory meetings
* strong communication and project\-management habits
* capacity to provide regular progress updates and document completed work

a structured weekly commitment will be established with selected fellows based on the project requirements and, where applicable, academic internship requirements.

important — unpaid fellowship

**this is an unpaid internship/fellowship opportunity.**

there is **no salary, hourly wage, stipend, or guarantee of future paid employment associated with participation in the fellowship.**

the program is intended primarily as a supervised educational, research, professional\-development, and experiential\-learning opportunity.

applicants should apply only if they understand and accept the unpaid nature of the fellowship.

why this fellowship is different

many internships ask participants to observe existing systems.

this fellowship provides an opportunity to help **build one**.

the successful candidate could contribute to the scientific foundation of an emerging international forecasting platform designed to connect:

**collective trauma → political stress → institutional vulnerability → conflict probability → early warning → organizational impact → preparedness**

for a quantitatively talented candidate interested in using data science to understand some of the world's most consequential problems, this fellowship offers an unusually substantive research challenge.

how to apply

please submit:

* resume/cv
* brief statement explaining your interest in the fellowship
* description of your statistical modeling experience
* description of your experience with python, r, matlab, sql, or comparable analytical tools
* description of any website development/maintenance experience
* optional link to github, portfolio, research project, dashboard, publication, or other relevant technical work

**please specifically describe a statistical or predictive model that you have personally built or substantially contributed to.**

applications that do not demonstrate quantitative/statistical capability may not be competitive for this fellowship.

advancing research, education, analytics, and global leadership at the intersection of trauma, conflict, institutional resilience, and human development.

* strong proficiency in server\-side javascript/typescript development with node.js.
* hands\-on experience with modern frontend frameworks such as vue.js and/or react.
* deep understanding of modern javascript, typescript, api design, and distributed application architecture.
* experience with sql and nosql databases in production environments.
* experience designing and consuming restful apis and graphql services.
* hands\-on experience building and operating cloud\-native applications; experience with google cloud platform is a plus.
* strong understanding of automated testing, ci/cd, observability, and modern devops practices.
* hands\-on experience using ai\-powered software development tools such as cursor, claude code, or comparable coding agents as part of day\-to\-day software development.
* demonstrated ability to use ai effectively across multiple stages of the software development lifecycle not simply for code generation.

* strong engineering fundamentals and the judgment to critically evaluate, test and improve ai\-generated solutions.
* independent problem solver capable of taking ambiguous problems from concept through production.

* commitment to building high\-quality, thoroughly tested, maintainable software.
* collaborative approach with a strong belief in teamwork, knowledge sharing, and collective ownership.

* 8\+ years of hands\-on software development experience.
* strong analytical, architectural, and problem\-solving skills.
* ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and continuously evolving engineering environment.
* passion for building exceptional user experiences.
* commitment to engineering excellence across architecture, code quality, automated testing, documentation, deployment, and production operations.

title: Software Engineer Senior-Ai Engineer
description:
**job profile****position overview**
=====================


at pnc, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. we are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. we work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. as a software engineer senior within pnc's technology organization, you will be based in dallas, tx or pittsburgh, pa.  

  

pnc is seeking an ai engineer with strong expertise in building and deploying llm\-powered, production\-grade systems. this role requires end\-to\-end ownership across model development, optimization, and real\-world integration.  

core skills \& expertise  

  

llm fine\-tuning \& modeling:  

hands\-on experience with peft, lora/qlora, and instruction tuning; building domain\-adapted models using curated datasets.  

  

llm optimization \& prompting:  

deep understanding of sampling strategies (temperature, top\-k/top\-p), prompt engineering, and techniques to improve accuracy, reduce hallucinations, and control outputs.  

  

production ai system integration:  

experience deploying llms into real\-world environments, including rag pipelines, api orchestration, agents, and multi\-turn conversational systems integrated with enterprise data.  

  

model serving \& performance engineering:  

proficiency with modern inference frameworks (vllm, tgi, triton), quantization (4/8\-bit), and optimizing for latency, throughput, and scalability.  

  

end\-to\-end ml lifecycle ownership:  

proven ability to build and manage pipelines across training, deployment, monitoring, and evaluation, including regression tracking and performance metrics.  

  

agentic \& autonomous systems:  

experience designing ai agents and multi\-agent workflows, balancing model reasoning with deterministic business logic.  

  

tech stack \& foundations:  

strong programming in python, with frameworks like pytorch/tensorflow, and libraries such as huggingface transformers.  

  

experience with vector databases, embeddings, and rag architectures  

familiarity with financial services data and regulated environments  

knowledge of responsible ai, governance, and model risk frameworks  

focus on production\-quality engineering, scalability, and cost optimization
pnc is an in\-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. we encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.  


pnc will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in stem opt for this position.**job description**
===================

* provides detailed technical design and development of software solutions using existing and emerging technology platforms.
* proposes \& designs software solutions to address complex business needs.
* writes code, tests and deploys software.
* prepares technical and procedural documentation required for software.
* maintains and debugs software.


pnc employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

* **customer focused** \- knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
* **managing risk** \- assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support pnc's enterprise risk management framework.

**qualifications**
==================


successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

**preferred skills**
--------------------


application development, business management, customer solutions, design, group problem solving, process improvements, release management, software solutions, user experience (ux) design**competencies**
----------------


application delivery process, application design, architecture, application development tools, application testing, packaged application integration, system development life cycle, technical troubleshooting, technical writing/documentation**work experience**
-------------------


roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3\+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. certifications are often desired. in lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.**education**
-------------


bachelors**certifications**
------------------


no required certification(s)**licenses**
------------


no required license(s)**benefits**
============


pnc offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. depending on your eligibility, options for full\-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a health savings account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long\-term disability protection; 401(k) with pnc match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back\-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.
in addition, pnc generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.
to learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part\-time employees, visit pncthrive.com.

=======================================


if an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at accommodationrequest@pnc.com. please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job id, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. applicants may also call 877\-968\-7762 and say "workday" for accommodation assistance. all information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.  



  

at pnc we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. we provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.
